Here are some more weird and worrying questions from the "What if?" inbox.
Justin asks, "What is the total nutritional value (calories, fat, minerals, etc.) of the average human body?" Justin, you know that question sounds at least a little bit suspicious, right?
Kenneth asks, "What if every day every human had a 1% chance of being turned into a turkey, and every turkey had a 1% chance of being turned into a human?"
Kenneth, you don't know someone named Justin, do you? I'm a little concerned about what you two are planning.
Devor asks, "In Thor, the main character is at one point spinning his hammer so fast that he creates a strong tornado. Would this be possible in real life?" No.
Jonathan asks, "If you saved a whole life's worth of kissing and used all that suction power on one single kiss, how much suction force would that single kiss have?"
Jonathan, based on your phrasing, I am actually a little concerned about the amount of suction that you think a normal kiss should have.
Chris asks, "Could you survive a tidal wave by submerging yourself in an in-ground pool?" Chris, I don't think I'd try that unless I had Thor's hammer with me.
